# Local interface fonts

Tradermath’s trainers page was inspected in Chrome on 2026-10-02: Teodor for headings, Geist for body text, and Geist Mono for navigation.

- Geist and Geist Mono variable WOFF2: official npm `geist@1.7.2` by Vercel; SIL Open Font License included.
- Instrument Serif regular Latin and extended Latin WOFF2: npm `@fontsource/instrument-serif@5.3.0`; SIL Open Font License included.

Instrument Serif provides a similar heading style. The commercial Teodor font is not bundled. All assets load locally; mathematical notation retains KaTeX fonts.

Sources: https://vercel.com/font ; https://github.com/Instrument/instrument-serif ; https://displaay.net/typeface/teodor
